key_observations: AttlibData parse on ams1112 attlib.dat yields: 8884 attribute records, 4760 nouns in noun_attr_map, but only 24 attr_def_map entries (clearly broken)

root_cause: e3d-attlib::parser::parse_atgtdf reads pages linearly via SeekFrom::Start (page_idx start_page..start_page+10). The IDA reference implementation sub_55F53B8 uses FHDBRN(handle, &page_no, ...) which walks the DB's INTERNAL DIRECTORY CHAIN, not linear file pages. As a result, only the first guessed page is parsed correctly (24 entries); subsequent linear pages contain unrelated data and break parsing.

title: IDA evidence: ATTOPE dir-page slots + true table names (ATGTIX/ATGTDF/ATGTSX, not ATTR/ATGTDF/ATNAIN)

ida_findings.sub_55F4290: ATTOPE — opens attlib file via FHFIND, then loads 6 tables (system + UDA, each having an index + types + series) from dir-page slots v47[0..7]

dir_page_layout.dir[0]: system ATGTDF start (1-indexed page no, Fortran convention)
dir_page_layout.dir[2]: system ATGTIX start (NOT 'ATTR table' — this is the hash→page-offset INDEX)

sub_55F4FFC_ATGTIX.format: 2-word records: (hash, packed) where packed = page_no*512 + word_offset_in_page
sub_55F4FFC_ATGTIX.termination: hash==0 advances to next page; hash==DELIMITER (0xFFFFFFFF) ends table

sub_55F53B8_ATGTDF.format: 3-word records: (hash, type, kind); kind==2 has extension (1 size word, or for type==4 a count + count words)

sub_55F594C_ATGTSX.format: 3-word records: 3 consecutive words per entry, terminating on 0 or DELIMITER
sub_55F594C_ATGTSX.semantic: TBD — likely (noun_hash, attr_hash_or_idx, type_code) for noun-attribute schema; the existing e3d-attlib treats it as ATNAIN which is structurally close but the names ATNAIN/ATTR are misnomers

design_decisions.SYNO_walker_scope: Returns the chain pointer as AttrValue::DbRef rather than recursing into the referenced element. Recursion needs the engine to load that element, which is out of scope for a record-level helper. Caller can recurse by calling find_element(ref) + decode_attribute_by_hash again.
design_decisions.is_zero_or_default_predicate: Centralised so future additions (e.g. default-pool support) only need to update one place. Treats RAW_USE_DEFAULT as zero-equivalent because callers can't distinguish 'real zero' from 'default sentinel' until the default pool is exposed.
design_decisions.LookupError_semantics: NotInAttlib is the common case (hash not present in ATGTDF — could be UDA, could be junk). PositionTooLarge is theoretical (ATGTDF positions fit in u16 in practice but the helper guards against pathological data).
